capture: Native app fixtures, isolated preferences, no reader or PIN. Native 09:41 clocks on complete mobile frames; only recorded focus/window crops and 2:1 Mac Retina downsampling.
scope: Affected guide panels only: RSA forms on seven device forms; iPhone authentication/Settings; iPhone/iPad document actions; Android phone/tablet Verify and browser authentication.
retained: Unchanged landing light/dark scenes, unaffected signing/card/reader screenshots and CLI command illustrations were audited and retained. Existing Apple Verify navbar images already match the unchanged native UI; their Clear results callouts were updated.
fixtureSourceChanges: Linux and Windows Debug protection preview selects the RSA form and asymmetric filename for certificate scenarios.
Apple readiness pipe is unbuffered to avoid missing a buffered readiness line.
Android guide captures explicitly request the 24-hour clock.

iphone.configuration: Debug iOS Simulator, iPhone 17 Pro / iOS 27.0

ipad.configuration: Debug iOS Simulator, iPad mini / iOS 27.0

macos.configuration: AppStore Debug; development-signed with existing matching profile, sandbox and smartcard entitlements verified

windows.configuration: Debug x64 WinUI 3; native Windows 11 ARM64 QEMU VM interactive session; fresh isolated source copy

linux.configuration: Debug Swift 6.4.1 / GTK4 4.22.5 / libadwaita 1.9.4; Fedora 44 ARM64 QEMU VM; X11 Xvfb native windows, cairo renderer

limitations: Fictional UI evidence does not demonstrate real NFC/USB, PIN reuse, cryptography, card decryption, trust validation, Siri or cross-device behavior.
These are current local Debug source captures, not a released application or Store submission.
